_about: Frederic D. Allen (1844-1897), Professor at Yale, later Harvard, raw IA OCR of Remnants of Early Latin, selected and explained for the use of students (Boston: Ginn, first entered 1880; this printing carries a 1908 copyright line). Latin texts with English introduction and notes, kept under lane B's extension of Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling to Latin-dense volumes. Latin literary history (lane B, round dy: fifth IA subject sweep). No uids minted. Round dz (2026-10-23), raw IA: his school Medea of Euripides in Clifford H. Moore's revised edition (Ginn, 1900; Moore died 1931, US public domain by date). Not taken: De Dialecto Locrensium (1870, Latin).
